{{Top|leg}}
'''Vosso''' was a type of [[Wood/Legends|wood]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. It was too dense for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] to build boats to travel from [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] to [[Alanciar]].<ref name="pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>
